qualityRule: Null/absent means unavailable. Missing environmental values never default to GREEN.

bom.note: Supply BOM Climate Data Online daily/hourly CSV export. Free CDO downloads exist, but extraction/download URLs are not durable.

waternsw.note: Supply WaterInsights/WaterNSW 15-minute export or a configured keyed API URL.

imos.note: Supply IMOS/BOM marine point extraction for the six pilot sites.

incidents.note: Supply Taronga ASID / DPI export. Public reporting is not silently substituted.
